data.gender_notes: Ainan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A place of fresh water that flows from a mountain. The name Ainan carries the meaning “Mountain spring” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ainan usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain spring and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Ainan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain spring.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ainan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.long_meaning: يعود أصل الكلمة إلى الجذر ع-ن- ويعني الخلاص من العبودية والحرية من العمل والراحة، وتسمى العبودية بالرذيلة والشيب، فيكون العبد من يحتقر نفسه، والحر من يرفع رأسه ويرضي نفسه، كما يمكن أن يعني الإحسان والخير، وفي بعض الحالات يطلق على المطربين، ويعتبر أصل الكلمة من أصل إسلامي، وقد ذكرت في القرآن الكريم في سورة يوسف، ويعود تاريخها إلى قبل الإسلام

in_english.name: Ainan
in_english.meaning: Freedom from servitude, relief from labor, freedom and happiness
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ainan is derived from the Arabic root 'A-N-A', which means freedom from servitude, relief from labor, and freedom. In Arabic culture, servitude is considered a form of ignorance, and the free person is one who has a strong sense of self-respect and self-esteem. The name Ainan also carries a connotation of goodness and kindness, and in some cases, it is used to refer to musicians. The name has its roots in pre-Islamic Arabia and is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Yusuf. The name has a rich history and spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, and it is considered a blessed name for a child.
